findings.title: Missed dark-theme conversion for category badge notification color
findings.body: This occurrence still uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) instead of dark-light-choose with $secondary. On dark themes this computes a dark shade from the light $primary, leaving .topic-list.categories .badge-notification low-contrast or unreadable on the dark background. It should be converted to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)).

findings.title: Wrong lightness values for embedded-posts h5 link
findings.body: The original color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), but the replacement uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) for light themes and scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%) for dark themes. The light-theme color becomes much lighter than intended, and the dark-theme fallback should be $secondary at 70%, not 30%. This makes embedded-post author links too faint in light themes and incorrectly colored in dark themes. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Group member name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: This rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), but the dark-light-choose replacement uses 50% for both $primary and $secondary. The light-theme color is now lighter than before, and the dark-theme value should be $secondary at 70%, not 50%. This alters .group-member-info .name styling in user streams. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Group member name color changed from 30% to 50% lightness
findings.body: This mobile rule originally used scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), but the replacement uses 50% for both $primary and $secondary. That changes the light-theme color from a dark 30% to a medium 50%, and the dark-theme fallback should be $secondary at 70%, not 50%. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Swapped custom-message-length lightness values
findings.body: The original color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), but the replacement uses $primary at 30% and $secondary at 70%. The light-theme color changes from a light 70% to a dark 30%, and the dark-theme fallback becomes too light. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)).

findings.title: Topic map h3 color changed from 20% to 50% lightness
findings.body: The original color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), but the replacement uses 50% for both $primary and $secondary. This lightens the heading in light themes and uses the wrong dark-theme fallback; it should be $secondary at 80%, not 50%. This affects .topic-map h3 on mobile. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%)).
